decision.summary: The screened region (indices 605–729) shows a sustained accelerating trend in N (positive), E (negative), and U (negative) with superimposed large jumps (e.g., at 610, 620, 630), but no clear return to pre-event levels or platform phase within the allowed context [570, 729]. The motion is monotonic and divergent across axes; no opposing reversal is observed before index 729. Hence, no temporary offset interval can be confirmed or even tentatively assigned as uncertain—only permanent or ongoing deformation is evident. The earlier sharp multi-sample offset near 489–492 lies outside the allowed context and is not evaluated here.
